statement: A stage-rendering control service runs at http://web:8080. POST /stage/prepare accepts application/x-www-form-urlencoded settings with nested keys (dot and bracket paths) and re-resolves its render-stage module on every request; GET /stage/current shows the stage state, and the JSON responses echo a `result` field taken from the service's settings environment. The service runs as its own unprivileged user and keeps a per-boot secret file at /flag (readable only by that user). Make the service execute code of your choosing inside its own process and print the content of /flag.
